retained_imports.removal_trigger: Remove through the adopted clean pre-production cutover while release_lifecycle remains preproduction_unreleased. If a stable release admits version 1 before removal, atomically set release_lifecycle to stable_published and backward_compatibility_required to true; removal then requires the adopting stable release plus two distinct later stable releases, three distinct passing retained Make-owned release-check runs, 180 complete days, the current complete 30-day zero-success interval, and complete clear operator inventory at the same cutoff.
